title: Orange sauce for pork.
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
small onion, thinly sliced
1
good inch grated ginger
2
tablespoons dark soy sauce
1
desertspoon Dijon mustard
2
desertspoons good marmalade
4
cloves garlic crushed
1
tablespoons honey
seasoning

4
cloves garlic crushed
1
tablespoons honey
seasoning

Method:-
Combine onion, ginger, soy sauce, mustard, marmalade, garlic and honey in a small bowl and mix well.
Fry mixture in a pan for 10 minutes.
.
It can now be poured over pork for its final cooking or used differently (with perhaps more cooking).
